outcome: The public CLI installs, invokes, updates and uninstalls as `atomwright`, existing local state migrates without destruction, and no public executable or release asset is named gentle-ai.

commits.note: `final` is the implementation commit. The branch head additionally contains this evidence file, which cannot record its own hash.

canonical_identifiers.source_module_path_note: Deliberately unchanged. It is resolved by the Go module proxy, not a branding surface. internal/identity asserts it is never derived from the release coordinates.

diff_composition.size_exception_justification: The repository review budget is 400 changed lines. 50% of this diff is tests and 16% is documentation; the production change is 1301 lines across one indivisible outcome. Splitting it would leave main in a fail-closed release state between merges, because the five release-identity strings (goreleaser project_name/binary, update registry Name/Owner/Repo, tar member, checksum filename, minisign trusted comment) are verified against each other and must move atomically.

explicit_proofs.no_public_executable_or_release_asset_na: TestNoPublicReleaseArtifactNamedGentleAI scans .goreleaser.yaml, release.yml, promote-stable-rc.yml, verify-release-assets.sh and promote-stable-preflight.sh. Confirmed independently by inspecting the snapshot dist/ output and checksums.txt: every platform archive and its tar member is named atomwright. The sole remaining gentle-ai-named asset is the provider-contract bundle, which is a protocol identifier and not an executable.
explicit_proofs.updater_does_not_target_upstream: TestUpdaterNeverTargetsUpstreamRepository scans every non-test file under internal/update and fails on any pairing of the upstream owner with this product, including the previously hardcoded advisory URL. The update registry now names pablogore/atomwright.
explicit_proofs.legacy_state_is_not_deleted_or_overwritt: TestMigrationNeverDeletesLegacyData and TestMigrationNeverOverwritesExistingAtomwrightState, plus real-binary runs confirming the legacy root survives migration and that a divergent target root is refused without modification.

known_limitations: next_transition.execute.command still renders the 'gentle-ai review ...' spelling because the published v2 schemas pin it. Callers should route from operation and arguments. Resolving this requires a review-integration contract version bump.
Homebrew is not a supported install path. Restoring it requires an Atomwright-owned tap and a token.
Windows binary distribution remains on the inherited hold pending Authenticode signing; go install is the supported Windows path.
internal/app TestRunArgs_UpgradeDryRun performs a live update check, so it depends on network availability. Its assertion now accepts a failed check as a legitimate no-upgrade outcome.

Documentation files not in the installation or migration path still carry inherited invocation examples (docs/telemetry-collector.md, docs/components.md, docs/kiro.md and others). Listed in upstream-baseline.md as deferred.
The GoReleaser snapshot was produced with signing skipped and a placeholder public-key ldflag; signature identity binding is asserted by tests, not by a signed local artifact.
